# Paved plugin 2.30.0

Paved gives coding agents repository context and a governed workflow for changes. Start with intent, review and approve a plan, then execute with tests, verification and evidence. The plugin activates a version-pinned runtime in the repository. Use the local Workbench to follow runs and recent Claude Code or Codex activity.

This directory is the installable plugin for Codex and Cursor. It is generated by
`npm run build:plugin` in the Paved repository and must not be edited by hand.

- Plugin package version: `2.30.0`
- Runtime: `paved-core@2.30.0` unpacked at `runtime/paved-core/`; its dependencies are bundled in its `node_modules/`.
- Runtime integrity: `sha512-Q+K8P0puZPmTDh9CK81XKXIET1WyhT3r2bb9WwQHPvn+Wu02HF3D5UKjm7OgN+KT9UvWQnSRaHTCUVJBS5RT+w==`, checked over the runtime and its dependencies before activation
- Launcher: `scripts/paved.mjs`
- Lifecycle hooks: `hooks/hooks.json` adds a short session index and requests continuation when changed-file verification fails on supported, trusted hosts.
- Optional update helper: from an initialized project, explicitly run `node "<plugin>/scripts/paved.mjs" auto-update configure --host codex --mode auto --interval-hours 24 --json`; use `auto-update status --json`, `auto-update check --host <host> --json`, or configure `--mode off` / `--mode notify`. Defaults are off. SessionStart checks due updates only after explicit authorization; UserPromptSubmit is not used. Cursor remains manual.
- Workbench: `paved workbench start` opens the local run dashboard; optional lifecycle hooks show recent agent activity only while it is running.
- Skills: `paved:<command>` in Codex and `/status` (or another skill name) in Cursor

Installation and usage: https://github.com/andersonmrodrigues/paved/blob/main/docs/getting-started/installing-the-plugin.md
